mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns, as high policy rates signal monetary tightening that reduces equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 1.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns, as the market prices delayed policy responses that support real economic activity and equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 (thousands) signals a weakening housing market, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic activity.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising (monthly growth > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of tight labor market (UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns, as strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
regime_hint: tight labor market (UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly)
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) fall below their 3-month moving averages, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns, as a simultaneous decline signals a broad-based economic slowdown.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS are both below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals a weakening economy, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and economic activity.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.
